finding.description: The body creates and fsyncs LAUNCH.json after systemd submission, then returns to main. The only SCORE_D directory fsync occurs before submit_once, after ADMISSION.json and unit.log creation. main subsequently rereads LAUNCH.json and returns the four-key reply without fsyncing SCORE_D after the LAUNCH directory entry was created. File fsync alone does not durably commit that directory entry, so the required durable launch receipt is not established before the reply.
finding.required_correction: Add a narrowly scoped fsync of the already-created SCORE_D directory after successful submit_once/LAUNCH.json creation and before the launch reread or outer reply. Preserve the existing unknown-outcome/no-retry branch and all other body bytes.

decision: This exact body is not authorized by this review for an actual score-unit admission. Preserve it and its binding as historical source; any corrected body requires a new versioned source review.
